title: parloa-documentary
prompt:
Use case: ads-marketing.
Asset: ONE original Japanese call-center recruitment HERO image, wide landscape aspect about 1938:811 (2.39:1). This is a new site-referenced creative direction, not a website screenshot or a clone.
Input image 1: actual saved website screenshot of Parloa, https://www.parloa.com/. Study its composition, type hierarchy and imagery treatment. Input image 2: our current call-center image, used ONLY for subject context (headsets, operators, call-center equipment), not its repeated anime arrangement.
Observed reference element: 仕事中の自然な人物を広い写真で見せ、空いた面に文字を重ねる。会話の文脈が伝わる場面づくり。
Direction: Use the Parloa screenshot's candid CINEMATIC work-in-progress photography and conversation-context framing, translated to a bright Japanese call center. Original Japanese male operator on RIGHT at his workstation, in side three-quarter view mid-call with boom-mic headset, daylight highlights, a blurred colleague behind. LEFT side is a quiet bright white office wall for a refined large navy serif headline; the photograph naturally fades into the white edge. Across right-middle add two small airy hand-drawn speech cues labeled only 電話対応 and サポート, without imitation SaaS chat cards. Photographic, unposed, storytelling composition, no copied customer chat or fake timings.
Exact ORIGINAL approved copy: small label "CALL CENTER RECRUIT"; headline "会話を、" / "価値に変える。"; subcopy "声を届ける仲間を、募集しています。". Use these strings ONLY, plus 電話対応 / 営業 / サポート / チーム if small work labels are needed. Do not copy any text from the attached website screenshot.
Keep call-center theme recognizable: professional communications headsets worn on heads with natural boom microphones, customer-contact workstation/screens with unreadable interface text, desk telephone or call-script papers. All human foreground staff Japanese adults. Natural proportions and coherent anatomy. Photographic concepts must be photographs; illustrative/sculptural concepts must follow their distinct direction.
Palette: mostly white, navy, cobalt blue and pale blue/teal, natural skin tones. The attached site's other brand colors are reference context, not output requirements. Keep bright edges that suit a white page, with no full dark rectangular background.
NO copied company logos, brands, slogans, named people, identity recreation, dates, certifications, customer quotes, salary/benefit promises, numerical claims, header/navigation, website CTA, browser chrome, watermarks or multiple concept thumbnails. No company-specific recruitment conditions. Preserve legibility, avoid cropped lettering or faces. Output exactly one finished opaque hero image, not a full page.

attached_images.role: actual website screenshot; cinematic work-in-progress framing reference

borrowed_visual_element: 仕事中の自然な人物を広い写真で見せ、空いた面に文字を重ねる。会話の文脈が伝わる場面づくり。

visual_inspection.headline: Exact and readable: 会話を、 / 価値に変える。
visual_inspection.subcopy: Exact and readable: 声を届ける仲間を、募集しています。
visual_inspection.reference_composition: Candid side three-quarter operator photo with contextual blurred colleague, generous left text area, refined serif headline and conversation cues.
visual_inspection.call_center: Professional headsets worn on heads with boom microphones; desk phone, scripts and customer-contact workstation visible.
visual_inspection.source_identity: No copied source logos, person identity, client chats, stats or claims.
issues: Foreground hand holds a small dark oval adjacent to the headset microphone; appears like an extra microphone tip. Core headset and call-center theme remain clear.
